title: VoClyp Canonical Event Envelope v1
description: Thin event payload delivered by signed webhooks. Carries a resource reference and fetch URL, never insight content: consumers retrieve the full document via the authenticated REST API. Changes are additive-only within this major version. Consumers must deduplicate on event_id (delivery is at-least-once), use sequence to discard stale events, and verify the X-Voclyp-Signature header against the raw body.

event_id.description: UUIDv7; globally unique, time-ordered. The consumer's idempotency/deduplication key.

event_type.description: Namespaced. New types may be added within this major version; consumers must ignore unknown types.

occurred_at.description: When the state change was committed (immutable across retries).

delivered_at.description: When this delivery attempt was made; retries carry a fresh value.

tenant_id.description: Consumers must verify this matches their own tenancy before processing.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-resource counter; discard events with a sequence lower than the last one processed for the same resource so a delayed older event never overwrites newer state.

fetch_url.description: Authenticated REST path (or absolute URL when the platform's public base URL is configured) to retrieve the full resource.
